products.name: JAIS (G42 / Inception)
products.note: Arabic-centric LLM; UAE sovereign AI; cultural alignment; Middle East data governance

profile_text.body:
G42 is a technology group founded in Abu Dhabi that describes itself as inventing artificial intelligence for use across industries and societies. The company says it operates in over 30 countries and is organized around ten companies sharing a single mission it calls the Intelligence Grid, which it describes as a unified backbone connecting compute, cloud, data centers, connectivity, and domain-specific AI solutions across sectors including healthcare, energy, governance, and security.

The company's tracked AI product is JAIS, an Arabic-centric large language model positioned as a UAE sovereign AI offering, with an emphasis on cultural alignment and Middle East data governance. G42's site also describes a voice-driven generative interface designed to adapt to individual intent and respond in real time to information queries, as well as personalized executive briefings, framing these as part of what it calls an AI-native web experience.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
